heroHeadline: FDA Approves Pirtobrutinib for First-Line CLL/SLL — First Non-Covalent BTK Inhibitor in Frontline Setting — Days After Belzutifan-Lenvatinib Clears for Advanced Kidney Cancer
heroSubtitle: On October 2, 2026, the FDA approved pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca) for previously untreated CLL/SLL without 17p deletion, based on BRUIN CLL-313, where progression or death risk fell 80% versus bendamustine-rituximab. On September 24, the agency approved belzutifan plus lenvatinib for advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma after PD-1/PD-L1 therapy, with median PFS of 14.6 versus 10.6 months for cabozantinib in LITESPARK-011.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA Drug Approvals, NIH/NCI, peer-reviewed journals (NEJM, The Lancet, JCO, Nature, Nature Medicine), ASCO/ESMO/AACR conference data, and institutional analyses. All clinical data reflect published and presented trial results.
